meta.name: deck-blueprint
meta.description: 奶油纸 + 锈红 + 蓝图网格 mask + 黑边硬卡片 + pipeline 盒

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为卡片添加复古蓝图风格的装饰效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在设计中加入蓝图网格和锈红奶油色调的卡片元素。
copy.tagline_en: Add retro blueprint-style decorative effects to cards.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add blueprint grid and rust-red cream tones to card designs.

howto.what: 生成 16:9 的架构 / pipeline 讲解幻灯片:奶油 #F0EAE0 底 + 蓝图 48px 网格 mask、pipeline 步骤盒(其一抬高)、右侧锈红 #B5392A insight 标注、Playfair 衬线大字与 SVG 虚线反馈环,零渐变零软阴影。
howto.when: 需要认真、适合打印的架构或 pipeline 讲解 deck 时接管。

say.text: 用 deck-blueprint 做一页 pipeline 讲解,步骤盒抬高一格

howto.what_en: Builds 16:9 architecture/pipeline slides: cream #F0EAE0 background with a 48px blueprint grid mask, pipeline step boxes (one raised), a rust-red #B5392A insight callout on the right, Playfair serif large type and an SVG dashed feedback loop, no gradients or soft shadows.
howto.when_en: Use when you need a serious, print-friendly architecture or pipeline explainer deck.
